start.text:
Mount Ashenveil — an active volcano at the edge of the Fireborn Range — is home to Inferaxis, an ancient red dragon who has terrorized the surrounding kingdoms for centuries. The Dragon Council (yes, even other dragons fear this one) has issued a bounty.

You stand at the volcano's base. Lava rivers glow orange through cracks in the black stone. The air shimmers with heat.

Three paths lead upward: the Pilgrim's Trail (wide, exposed), the Lava Tubes (underground, dangerous), and the Dragon's Spine ridge (narrow, treacherous).

choices.text: Take the Pilgrim's Trail — the known path
Enter the Lava Tubes underground
Scale the Dragon's Spine ridge
Search for a guide who knows the mountain

find_guide.text:
In a cave near the base, you find Kaela — a dragonborn exile who once served Inferaxis. 'I left when he demanded I sacrifice my own kin. I know every tunnel, every trap, every weakness.'

She agrees to guide you. 'His left eye is blind — old wound from a rival. Approach from his left and he can't see you.'

choices.text: Take the Lava Tubes with Kaela's guidance
Scale the ridge with her help

pilgrim_trail.text:
The Pilgrim's Trail is wide but exposed. Halfway up, dragon fire scorches the path — Inferaxis patrols his domain from the air.

A massive shadow passes overhead. You have seconds to react!

choices.text: Dive behind a boulder for cover!
Stand your ground and challenge the dragon!
Continue

cover_success.text:
Dragon fire blasts the trail where you stood, turning rock to slag. But you're safe behind the boulder. The dragon passes, circling higher.

You see the lair entrance — a massive cave mouth glowing with inner fire — at the summit.

choices.text: Sprint to the lair entrance while he circles
Wait for him to land, then follow

fire_hit.text: Dragon fire clips your side! The heat is unbearable — your armor glows. You pat out the flames and scramble to cover.

choices.text: Press on to the lair

early_challenge.text:
The dragon banks and hovers, amused. His voice booms: 'A tiny creature dares challenge ME on MY mountain? How delightful. I'll enjoy roasting you slowly.'

He lands on a ledge above you — enormous, scales like crimson armor, eyes burning with ancient malice.

choices.text: Attack while he gloats!
Dive into a cave opening nearby!

lava_tubes.text:
The lava tubes are sweltering. Ancient tunnels carved by flowing magma, some still active. You navigate by the faint glow of cooling rock.

A fork: one tube leads upward with breathable air, the other glows ominously bright — active lava flow.

choices.text: Take the safe upper tube
Risk the lava tube — it's more direct

tubes_guided.text:
Kaela leads you through the tubes expertly, avoiding dead ends and active lava flows. 'This way — there's a back entrance to the hoard chamber. Inferaxis never guards it because no one's ever come this way alive.'

You emerge in a small cavern overlooking the dragon's treasure hoard.

choices.text: Sneak through the hoard to get close
Prepare an ambush from this vantage point

upper_tube.text: The upper tube is safer but winding. You emerge through a vent into the dragon's lair — specifically, the outer ring of his hoard chamber.

choices.text: Sneak through the treasure toward the dragon
Continue

lava_survived.text: You sprint through the lava tube, heat searing your lungs. A river of molten rock flows beside you, inches away. You reach the exit just as the tube narrows, emerging into cooler rock near the hoard.

choices.text: Enter the hoard chamber

lava_burned.text: Lava spray burns your arm! You rush through in agony but make it to the other side.

choices.text: Stagger into the hoard chamber
Continue

spine_success.text:
The Dragon's Spine is a razor-thin ridge of volcanic rock. One wrong step means a fall into lava below. You navigate it with sure feet and reach the summit directly above the lair entrance.

From here, you can drop down onto the dragon's back — if he's inside.

choices.text: Drop into the lair from above
Enter through the main cave mouth

spine_slip.text: You slip on loose volcanic rock! A desperate grab saves you from falling into the lava below, but you lose your pack.

choices.text: Continue to the lair entrance on foot

lair_entrance.text:
The lair entrance is a cathedral-sized cave. Heat radiates from within. Dragon claw-marks gouge the walls. The stench of sulfur is overwhelming.

Inside, the cave opens into the hoard chamber — mountains of gold, gems, and enchanted weapons. And there, coiled atop the largest pile, Inferaxis sleeps.

He's massive — sixty feet from snout to tail. His breathing sends waves of heat through the chamber.

choices.text: Sneak through the hoard to find a weapon
Attack while he sleeps!

lair_drop.text: You drop from above! Landing silently on a ledge overlooking the dragon's sleeping form. From here, you can see his blind left eye — milky white, the old wound Kaela mentioned.

choices.text: Strike at his blind side!
Look for a legendary weapon in the hoard first

hoard_sneak.text:
You creep through mountains of treasure. Gold coins shift treacherously underfoot. Among the hoard, you spot something extraordinary: a dragonslayer lance, glowing with silver fire. A weapon forged specifically to kill dragons.

Inferaxis stirs in his sleep.

choices.text: Grab the dragonslayer lance!
Leave the lance — use your own weapon and attack now

hoard_ambush.text: You set up in the vantage point with throwing weapons and a plan. When Inferaxis shifts, exposing his underbelly, you strike!

choices.text: Attack his exposed underbelly!
Continue

lance_obtained.text: Your fingers close around the dragonslayer lance. It hums with power — warm but controlled. Silver runes flare along its shaft. With this weapon, you have a real chance.

choices.text: Attack Inferaxis with the dragonslayer lance!

sleep_attack.text: You strike at the sleeping dragon...

choices.text: Continue

dragon_wakes.text:
Inferaxis's eyes snap open! A wave of heat blasts outward. 'THIEF!' His voice shakes the mountain.

He rears up, filling the chamber, wings spreading wide. Fire builds in his throat.

choices.text: Fight the dragon!
Continue

dragon_wounded.text:
Your attack strikes true — finding a gap in the ancient scales near his blind eye. Inferaxis ROARS in pain and fury, thrashing. Blood — hot as magma — splatters the gold.

'You DARE?!' The dragon's rage is terrifying. He unleashes a gout of fire that melts the gold around you.

choices.text: Press the attack — go for the kill!
Dodge the fire and strike at his wounded side!
Use the terrain — topple the gold pile on him!

dragon_retaliation.text: Inferaxis swats you with his tail! You fly across the hoard, crashing into a pile of gems.

choices.text: Get up and fight! This ends now!
Continue
Continue
Continue

dragon_last_stand.text:
Inferaxis fights with the fury of a dying god. His claws tear stone, his fire melts metal. But you won't stop. Neither can he — his wound is fatal, he just doesn't know it yet.

With a final, desperate lunge, you drive your weapon through the gap in his scales, into his heart.

choices.text: Watch the ancient dragon fall

dragon_slain.text:
Inferaxis sways. His burning eyes flicker. 'Impossible...' he whispers. 'I am... eternal...'

The great dragon crashes to the ground. Mount Ashenveil trembles. And then silence.

Inferaxis the Ancient is dead.

You stand in a mountain of treasure — gold, gems, enchanted artifacts — the accumulated wealth of a dragon who plundered kingdoms for a thousand years. You can only carry a fraction, but what a fraction it is.

The volcano rumbles. Without the dragon's magic stabilizing it, Mount Ashenveil will eventually erupt. Time to leave.

You descend the mountain as a legend. The Dragon Council acknowledges the bounty fulfilled. Kingdoms celebrate the end of terror. Bards compose epics. Children hear your name and dream of adventure.

You are the Dragonslayer. Forever.
